name: gmail
description: Read/draft/clear a personal Gmail or Google Workspace mailbox via the Gmail REST API over OAuth. List the inbox, show a message, archive mail, and stage reply/new drafts in the Drafts folder. Staging is draft-only; a reviewed draft is sent only on explicit per-message say-so via --send-draft. One OAuth sign-in also manages Gmail filters programmatically (list/create/append/delete).
